en: Job 38

p.src: 1  Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind,

en: Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind,
u.src: 1  Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind,

p.src: 2  “Who is this who darkens counsel by words without knowledge?

en: “Who is this who darkens counsel by words without knowledge?
u.src: 2  “Who is this who darkens counsel by words without knowledge?

p.src: 3  Brace yourself like a man, for I will question you, then you answer me!

ja: めよ。 私はあなたに
en: Brace yourself like a man, for I will question you, then you answer me!
u.src: 3  Brace yourself like a man, for I will question you, then you answer me!

p.src: 4  “Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth? Declare, if you have understanding.

ja: えたとき、あなたはどこにいたのか。
りがあるなら、告げてみよ。
en: “Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth? Declare, if you have understanding.
u.src: 4  “Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth? Declare, if you have understanding.

p.src: 5  Who determined its measures, if you know? Or who stretched the line on it?

ja: めたのか、あなたは知っているのか。 あるいは、誰がその
en: Who determined its measures, if you know? Or who stretched the line on it?
u.src: 5  Who determined its measures, if you know? Or who stretched the line on it?

p.src: 6  What were its foundations fastened on? Or who laid its cornerstone,

ja: に留められたのか。 あるいは、誰がその
en: What were its foundations fastened on? Or who laid its cornerstone,
u.src: 6  What were its foundations fastened on? Or who laid its cornerstone,

p.src: 7  when the morning stars sang together, and all the sons of God shouted for joy?

en: when the morning stars sang together, and all the sons of God shouted for joy?
u.src: 7  when the morning stars sang together, and all the sons of God shouted for joy?

p.src: 8  “Or who shut up the sea with doors, when it broke out of the womb,

en: “Or who shut up the sea with doors, when it broke out of the womb,
u.src: 8  “Or who shut up the sea with doors, when it broke out of the womb,

p.src: 9  when I made clouds its garment, and wrapped it in thick darkness,

ja: をその着物とし、 深い暗
en: when I made clouds its garment, and wrapped it in thick darkness,
u.src: 9  when I made clouds its garment, and wrapped it in thick darkness,

p.src: 10  marked out for it my bound, set bars and doors,

ja: 私がそのために境界を
め、 かんぬきと扉を設けて、
en: marked out for it my bound, set bars and doors,
u.src: 10  marked out for it my bound, set bars and doors,

p.src: 11  and said, ‘You may come here, but no further. Your proud waves shall be stopped here’?

ja: てもよいが、これ以上は進んではならない。 あなたの
められる』と言ったときに。
en: and said, ‘You may come here, but no further. Your proud waves shall be stopped here’?
u.src: 11  and said, ‘You may come here, but no further. Your proud waves shall be stopped here’?

p.src: 12  “Have you commanded the morning in your days, and caused the dawn to know its place,

ja: じたことがあるか。 夜明けにその
en: “Have you commanded the morning in your days, and caused the dawn to know its place,
u.src: 12  “Have you commanded the morning in your days, and caused the dawn to know its place,

p.src: 13  that it might take hold of the ends of the earth, and shake the wicked out of it?

ja: とさせたことがあるか。
en: that it might take hold of the ends of the earth, and shake the wicked out of it?
u.src: 13  that it might take hold of the ends of the earth, and shake the wicked out of it?

p.src: 14  It is changed as clay under the seal, and presented as a garment.

en: It is changed as clay under the seal, and presented as a garment.
u.src: 14  It is changed as clay under the seal, and presented as a garment.

p.src: 15  From the wicked, their light is withheld. The high arm is broken.

en: From the wicked, their light is withheld. The high arm is broken.
u.src: 15  From the wicked, their light is withheld. The high arm is broken.

p.src: 16  “Have you entered into the springs of the sea? Or have you walked in the recesses of the deep?

ja: ったことがあるか。 あるいは、
en: “Have you entered into the springs of the sea? Or have you walked in the recesses of the deep?
u.src: 16  “Have you entered into the springs of the sea? Or have you walked in the recesses of the deep?

p.src: 17  Have the gates of death been revealed to you? Or have you seen the gates of the shadow of death?

ja: があなたに示されたことがあるか。 あるいは、
en: Have the gates of death been revealed to you? Or have you seen the gates of the shadow of death?
u.src: 17  Have the gates of death been revealed to you? Or have you seen the gates of the shadow of death?

p.src: 18  Have you comprehended the earth in its width? Declare, if you know it all.

ja: がりを理解したことがあるか。 これらすべてを
っているなら、告げてみよ。
en: Have you comprehended the earth in its width? Declare, if you know it all.
u.src: 18  Have you comprehended the earth in its width? Declare, if you know it all.

p.src: 19  “What is the way to the dwelling of light? As for darkness, where is its place,

en: “What is the way to the dwelling of light? As for darkness, where is its place,
u.src: 19  “What is the way to the dwelling of light? As for darkness, where is its place,

p.src: 20  that you should take it to its bound, that you should discern the paths to its house?

ja: あなたは光と闇をそれぞれの
き、 その住まいへの
en: that you should take it to its bound, that you should discern the paths to its house?
u.src: 20  that you should take it to its bound, that you should discern the paths to its house?

p.src: 21  Surely you know, for you were born then, and the number of your days is great!

ja: まれており、 あなたの齢は、さぞ長いことだ！
en: Surely you know, for you were born then, and the number of your days is great!
u.src: 21  Surely you know, for you were born then, and the number of your days is great!

p.src: 22  Have you entered the storehouses of the snow, or have you seen the storehouses of the hail,

ja: ったことがあるか。 あるいは、
en: Have you entered the storehouses of the snow, or have you seen the storehouses of the hail,
u.src: 22  Have you entered the storehouses of the snow, or have you seen the storehouses of the hail,

p.src: 23  which I have reserved against the time of trouble, against the day of battle and war?

ja: のために、これらを取っておいた。
en: which I have reserved against the time of trouble, against the day of battle and war?
u.src: 23  which I have reserved against the time of trouble, against the day of battle and war?

p.src: 24  By what way is the lightning distributed, or the east wind scattered on the earth?

en: By what way is the lightning distributed, or the east wind scattered on the earth?
u.src: 24  By what way is the lightning distributed, or the east wind scattered on the earth?

p.src: 25  Who has cut a channel for the flood water, or the path for the thunderstorm,

en: Who has cut a channel for the flood water, or the path for the thunderstorm,
u.src: 25  Who has cut a channel for the flood water, or the path for the thunderstorm,

p.src: 26  to cause it to rain on a land where there is no man, on the wilderness, in which there is no man,

en: to cause it to rain on a land where there is no man, on the wilderness, in which there is no man,
u.src: 26  to cause it to rain on a land where there is no man, on the wilderness, in which there is no man,

p.src: 27  to satisfy the waste and desolate ground, to cause the tender grass to grow?

en: to satisfy the waste and desolate ground, to cause the tender grass to grow?
u.src: 27  to satisfy the waste and desolate ground, to cause the tender grass to grow?

p.src: 28  Does the rain have a father? Or who fathers the drops of dew?

ja: がいるのか。 あるいは、誰が
en: Does the rain have a father? Or who fathers the drops of dew?
u.src: 28  Does the rain have a father? Or who fathers the drops of dew?

p.src: 29  Whose womb did the ice come out of? Who has given birth to the gray frost of the sky?

en: Whose womb did the ice come out of? Who has given birth to the gray frost of the sky?
u.src: 29  Whose womb did the ice come out of? Who has given birth to the gray frost of the sky?

p.src: 30  The waters become hard like stone, when the surface of the deep is frozen.

en: The waters become hard like stone, when the surface of the deep is frozen.
u.src: 30  The waters become hard like stone, when the surface of the deep is frozen.

p.src: 31  “Can you bind the cluster of the Pleiades, or loosen the cords of Orion?

ja: あなたはプレアデス星団を
びつけたり、 オリオン座の綱を解いたりすることができるか。
en: “Can you bind the cluster of the Pleiades, or loosen the cords of Orion?
u.src: 31  “Can you bind the cluster of the Pleiades, or loosen the cords of Orion?

p.src: 32  Can you lead the constellations out in their season? Or can you guide the Bear with her cubs?

ja: 七星をその子らとともに
en: Can you lead the constellations out in their season? Or can you guide the Bear with her cubs?
u.src: 32  Can you lead the constellations out in their season? Or can you guide the Bear with her cubs?

p.src: 33  Do you know the laws of the heavens? Can you establish its dominion over the earth?

ja: に立てることができるか。
en: Do you know the laws of the heavens? Can you establish its dominion over the earth?
u.src: 33  Do you know the laws of the heavens? Can you establish its dominion over the earth?

p.src: 34  “Can you lift up your voice to the clouds, that abundance of waters may cover you?

en: “Can you lift up your voice to the clouds, that abundance of waters may cover you?
u.src: 34  “Can you lift up your voice to the clouds, that abundance of waters may cover you?

p.src: 35  Can you send out lightnings, that they may go? Do they report to you, ‘Here we are’?

ja: し、それらを走らせることができるか。 稲妻はあなたに『ここにいる』と答えるか。
en: Can you send out lightnings, that they may go? Do they report to you, ‘Here we are’?
u.src: 35  Can you send out lightnings, that they may go? Do they report to you, ‘Here we are’?

p.src: 36  Who has put wisdom in the inward parts? Or who has given understanding to the mind?

en: Who has put wisdom in the inward parts? Or who has given understanding to the mind?
u.src: 36  Who has put wisdom in the inward parts? Or who has given understanding to the mind?

p.src: 37  Who can count the clouds by wisdom? Or who can pour out the containers of the sky, 38  when the dust runs into a mass, and the clods of earth stick together?

ja: 誰が知恵をもって雲を数えられるか。 あるいは、誰が空の水がめを傾け注ぐことができるか。
いにくっつき合うときに。
zh: 誰能用智慧數算雲彩呢？ 塵土聚集成團，土塊緊緊結連； 那時，誰能傾倒天上的瓶呢？
en: Who can count the clouds by wisdom? Or who can pour out the containers of the sky,
when the dust runs into a mass, and the clods of earth stick together?
u.src: 37  Who can count the clouds by wisdom? Or who can pour out the containers of the sky, 38  when the dust runs into a mass, and the clods of earth stick together?

p.src: 39  “Can you hunt the prey for the lioness, or satisfy the appetite of the young lions, 40  when they crouch in their dens, and lie in wait in the thicket?

ja: あなたは雌獅子のために獲物を狩り、 若い獅子たちの食欲を満たすことができるか。
zh: 母獅子在洞中蹲伏， 少壯獅子在隱密處埋伏； 你能為牠們抓取食物， 使牠們飽足嗎？
en: “Can you hunt the prey for the lioness, or satisfy the appetite of the young lions,
when they crouch in their dens, and lie in wait in the thicket?
u.src: 39  “Can you hunt the prey for the lioness, or satisfy the appetite of the young lions, 40  when they crouch in their dens, and lie in wait in the thicket?

p.src: 41  Who provides for the raven his prey, when his young ones cry to God, and wander for lack of food?

ja: がなくてさまようとき、 誰がカラスのためにその獲物を備えるのか。
en: Who provides for the raven his prey, when his young ones cry to God, and wander for lack of food?
u.src: 41  Who provides for the raven his prey, when his young ones cry to God, and wander for lack of food?
